properties.name: Colombo National Museum
properties.description: The largest museum in Sri Lanka, housing royal regalia and ancient artifacts from the Kandyan kingdom.

properties.name: Gangaramaya Temple
properties.description: A highly revered temple mixing modern architecture and cultural essence, situated near Beira Lake.

properties.name: Galle Face Green
properties.description: A popular ocean-side urban park in the heart of Colombo. Great for sunset views and street food.

properties.name: Dehiwala Zoo
properties.description: The National Zoological Gardens of Sri Lanka, home to diverse wildlife and beautiful landscaped gardens.

properties.name: Seethawaka Botanical Garden
properties.description: A serene botanical garden located in the wet zone of Sri Lanka, perfect for nature walks.

properties.name: Diyasaru Park
properties.description: An urban wetland park in Thalawathugoda, excellent for bird watching and nature photography.

properties.name: Negombo Beach
properties.description: A vibrant coastal stretch in Gampaha district known for its golden sands, fishing communities, and lively atmosphere.

properties.name: Hamilton Canal
properties.description: A historic canal in Negombo built during the colonial era, lined with colorful fishing boats.
